game.name: Crysis 2 (Europe)(De,Tr)
game.desc: Crysis 2 on Xbox 360 is a first-person shooter developed by Crytek. Supposedly set 3 years after the events of the first installment, the game takes us to New York City, which is in the grip of an alien invasion. In the shoes of the Green Beret, the player must exploit the capabilities of his high-tech suit to survive in this urban jungle where the most formidable enemies are not necessarily those you think.
